ينفجر (form VII)
# يَنْفَجِرُ (yanfajiru) /jan.fa.d͡ʒi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# يُنْفَجَرُ (yunfajaru) /jun.fa.d͡ʒa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# يَنْفَجِرَ (yanfajira) /jan.fa.d͡ʒi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
